name: Hornero Disk Usage
description: Disk Usage 3.0 on Hornero Signal: every physical disk as a partition bar with a dimension line, free space and a near-full flag from the shared system provider. Read-only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Plain wording in footnotes and labels (no internal terms).
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: per-disk UiPartition bars with dimension lines and a signal-toned near-full flag.
Per-disk card on the shared System.disks facade: used/total/free in correct KiB units, most-full summary, near-full alerts, typed settings and Spanish catalog. No SMART data invented.
Dashboard card listing mounted disks with used/total space and a percentage bar.

warnPercent.description: Used percent at or above which a disk is flagged as nearly full.

showFreeSpace.description: Show free space under each disk (additive in 2.0) and the nearly-full hint.
